why: The student traces the first two lines correctly but then reads b = t as 'b equals a', as if t still followed a's current value, so they conclude both variables end up as b and never see the swap.

concepts.quote: Then b = t means b equals a
concepts.why: This treats t = a as a lasting link to a, but t keeps the value a had when it was assigned, so b gets the original a.
